question: How does the knower of the elevenfold powers cherish absorption moment by moment?
premises: There is a knower of the power of one's own parts marked by eleven.
This knower acts moment by moment.
inference: Mastery of the elevenfold powers sustains contemplative absorption continuously in every moment.
uncertainties: The precise referent of ekādaśāṅka is tradition-specific.
plain_english: The knower of the power of his own parts marked by eleven cherishes absorption moment by moment.
